note: The Malaysia campaign page https://www.specialoffers.jcb/en/campaign/d/southeast-and-south-asia/malaysia/ loads its tiles from this public JSON file. Each entry is one campaign page /en/campaign/detail/<name>/<id>/. Take eligibility from the 'Eligible members' section. Campaigns whose eligible members are only JCB cards issued in another country (on 20 Nov 2026: Agoda 94117 and Expedia 93355, Hong Kong) are left out and counted. One campaign page can hold more than one deal (Gleneagles Johor 96165 has benefit-a and benefit-b), so read it by hand when it changes.
